description: DeepSeek pay-as-you-go account balance via remote provider script.

parameters.name: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
parameters.label: DeepSeek API Key
parameters.description: DeepSeek API token for reading account balance.

parameters.name: DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_CURRENCY
parameters.label: Currency
parameters.description: Optional currency filter. Leave empty to show every currency returned by the API.

parameters.name: DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_WARNING_CNY
parameters.label: CNY warning balance
parameters.description: Shows a warning when the CNY balance is at or below this amount.

parameters.name: DEEPSEEK_BALANCE_REFERENCE_TOTAL_CNY
parameters.label: CNY reference total
parameters.description: Reference total used to render the balance progress bar.
